<onlyinclude><infobox type="align-right">
	<title source="battle">
	    <default>{{PAGENAME}}</default>
	</title>
	<image source="image"/>
	<data source="caption"/>
	<data source="location">
	    <label>Location</label>
	</data>
		<data source="date">
	    <label>Date</label>
	</data>
	<data source="result">
	    <label>Result</label>
	</data>
	<group row-items="2">
	<header>Combatants</header>
	    <data source="comba"/>
	    <data source="combb"/>
	    <data source="combc"/>
	    <data source="combd"/>
	    <data source="combe"/>
	    <data source="combf"/>
	</group>
	<group row-items="2">
	<header>Commanders</header>
	    <data source="cmda"/>
	    <data source="cmdb"/>
	    <data source="cmdc"/>
	    <data source="cmdd"/>
	    <data source="cmde"/>
	    <data source="cmdf"/>
	</group>
	<group row-items="2">
	<header>Strength</header>
	    <data source="stra"/>
	    <data source="strb"/>
	    <data source="strc"/>
	    <data source="strd"/>
	    <data source="stre"/>
	    <data source="strf"/>
	</group>
	<group row-items="2">
    <header>Casualties</header>
	    <data source="casa"/>
	    <data source="casb"/>
	    <data source="casc"/>
	    <data source="casd"/>
	    <data source="case"/>
	    <data source="casf"/>
	</group>
	<data source="casciv"/>
</infobox></onlyinclude>
[[Category:Infobox templates]]
